narrative: On the bookwheel. Brooke lies open on the board in the afternoon light. The tables are shut beside it and are not this page. Gib is on the corner of the book. No speech has been written under the two houses. The chronicle is not in the room.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not write a line for anyone to say.

entities.name: Brooke's Romeus and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on book in Two houses, and no speech
